text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: auth failure spike detected on inference-api-prod. alert_id=A-2520. 401s up ~20% in last 3m. origin: auth-proxy cluster eu-west-1. link: https://alerts.redwood/alert/A-2520
ashley: oncall (eve->ashley). I'm looking now, pulling up logs and metrics.
ashley: Quick metric snapshot: 1m avg 401 rate = 21.8%, baseline ~1.5%. Request volume normal. Suspect token validation failures.
sam: I can see the same in dashboards. Running tail on proxy logs for inference-api-prod: `kubectl -n infra-apis logs -l app=auth-proxy --since=5m`
sam: Querying logs for "invalid signature" and "token expired" now.
miguel: joining — any recent deploys to auth-proxy or token service?
deploy-bot: deploy completed: infra/auth-proxy image=auth-proxy:1.3.9 user=ci-cd pipeline=main at 2520006000
ashley: logs (snip): ```
2025-09-14T12:03:41Z auth-proxy inference-api-prod ERR invalid signature for token user=svc-infer
2025-09-14T12:03:42Z auth-proxy inference-api-prod WARN token validation failed: malformed header
2025-09-14T12:03:43Z auth-proxy inference-api-prod ERR signature verification timeout
```
claire: security here. Those messages look like signature mismatches rather than TTL expiry. Could be rotated signing key mismatch or a bad deploy. Containment: rotate the signing key for inference API service and fail open to canary. Also capture all affected tokens and IPs for forensics.
ashley: agreed. Plan: (1) create temporary signing key in KMS, (2) update auth-proxy config to accept new key + legacy for 30s, (3) roll canary, (4) monitor 401 rate, (5) if good, roll all. I'll start key creation.
sam: I'll add a temporary WAF rule to block obvious suspicious IPs hitting /v1/stream endpoints and throttle high-401 clients. SQL: N/A — adding AWS WAF rule now.
miguel: checking token-issuer service (issuer-v2). No recent config changes, but there's a deploy 2520005800 prior to this. Hard to see mismatch; maybe env var was not updated in the proxy image.
ashley: creating new key: `aws kms create-key --description "incident temp key A-2520"` then patching k8s secret. Applying to canary: `kubectl -n infra-apis set env deploy/auth-proxy SIGNING_KEY_ID=arn:aws:kms:...`
ashley: done — new key created and applied to auth-proxy-canary. Restarting canary pod.
miguel: verifying canary logs now.
miguel: canary shows 401s down from 22% -> 3.1% within 60s. Looks like signing mismatch was the cause.
ashley: rolling to 50% then 100% over next 3m. Doing config update and rolling restart.
customer-success: CS noticed two paying customers (AcmeCorp, BrightMart) reported failures ~12:02-12:07 UTC. We're drafting a message to acknowledge we're investigating and will update with timeline once mitigated.
legal: preserve all logs and DO NOT purge anything. We need full forensic copies for at least 90 days. Also collect list of affected accounts before any public comms.
sam: temp WAF rule applied. Traffic from 3 suspicious CIDRs blocked for now. Will remove once we have stable key rollout.
ashley: rolling complete. Metrics: global 401 rate dropped from 21.8% -> 2.9% over 4m. Error traces reduced.
claire: good containment. Next steps: rotate service signing keys in vault permanently, audit release gating to ensure env var consistency, and run a token-sample analysis to confirm no replay / exfil.
miguel: created ticket INF-9872 to audit signing key propagation and deploy checks. Assigning to eng-runtime.
ashley: opening post-incident PR to improve deploy checklists and add an e2e token validation step to CI.
customer-success: will send an interim customer note: "We observed authentication errors impacting small subset during 12:02-12:10 UTC; the issue is mitigated; full postmortem to follow." Waiting for legal sign-off.
legal: approve interim message. Hold on any mention of data access until we verify.
ashley: collecting anomalous IPs and logs to s3://redwood-incident-archive/A-2520/ for sec-ops. Claire, please confirm access for forensics.
claire: confirming—sec-ops team has access. Please include full request headers and token hashes.
sam: removing temporary WAF blocks in 30m if no regression.
ashley: closing live bridge. Follow-ups: INF-9872 (deploy gating), INF-9873 (postmortem + timeline), INF-9874 (key rotation to vault + HSM). Thanks all :thumbsup:
